datasetName: LandLedger India State/UT Official Data Register

classification.official: Government-published jurisdiction directory, DILRMP aggregate CLR progress, dated RoR directory metadata, NIC BhuNaksha listing flags, NGDRS published registration activity and Survey of India ABDB administrative geography.
classification.unavailable: Missing metrics or non-reported source fields remain null/not_reported. No owner, parcel, deed, title or mutation row is invented.
classification.synthetic: The distributed default ledger is empty. No demo owners or sample properties are seeded.

sources.publisher: Department of Land Resources, Government of India
sources.title: DILRMP MIS 3.0 State List / State Level CLR Report
sources.dataUse: Official 36 State/UT names, LGD codes, and State/UT classification.

sources.publisher: Department of Land Resources, Government of India
sources.title: Land Records State ROR On Web
sources.dataUse: Official dated RoR directory URLs/statuses. The published report contains 35 rows and excludes Ladakh.

sources.publisher: Department of Land Resources, Government of India / NGDRS
sources.title: National Dashboard – State-wise document registration statistics retrieved from live State IGR servers
sources.dataUse: State/UT registration statistics for the 26 rows reported by the dashboard; not land-record ownership statistics.

sources.publisher: NIC / Department of Land Resources, Government of India
sources.title: BhuNaksha customization list
sources.dataUse: List membership flag only; does not prove public parcel-level API availability.

sources.publisher: Survey of India, Government of India
sources.title: Administrative Boundary Data Base (ABDB)
sources.dataUse: Official administrative boundary source (State/District/Sub-District and Village layers). Geometry and hierarchy are not bundled because the uploaded 193 MB RAR could not be materialized in this runtime.

sources.name: DILRMP MIS 4.0 Map Digitization State/UT report
sources.publisher: Department of Land Resources, Government of India
sources.role: Official report schema for State/UT cadastral-map digitisation, map-to-RoR linkage, geo-referencing, land parcels and ULPIN indicators. The local package does not claim to have downloaded all district rows from this current report.

sources.name: DILRMP MIS 3.0 legacy Map Digitization / ULPIN report
sources.publisher: Department of Land Resources, Government of India
sources.role: Legacy national aggregate snapshot retained separately from MIS 4.0; source report does not expose a clear as-of date in the captured page.

sources.name: LACRRIS public dashboard
sources.publisher: Department of Land Resources, Government of India / NIC
sources.role: National land acquisition, area, project, displaced/affected families, compensation and R&R dashboard aggregates. Values are a public web-index snapshot; the source is state-updated and should be refreshed.

sources.name: LACRRIS state/UT acquisition progress report
sources.publisher: Department of Land Resources, Government of India / NIC
sources.role: Public State/UT, project and district report interface. State selection is required; the blank unfiltered page showing no rows is not evidence of zero acquisitions.

sources.name: LACRRIS district-wise acquisition progress report
sources.publisher: Department of Land Resources, Government of India / NIC
sources.role: Public report schema includes project, act, land-requiring body, district, land extent, SIA/notification/award/payment/possession timelines and compensation/R&R totals.

sources.name: Meghalaya Revenue & Disaster Management Department overview
sources.role: Official explanation of the State/Autonomous District Council land administration structure and the lack of uniform State-wide RoR.

sources.name: DILRMP State/UT RoR on Web directory (baseline) + later official portal supplements
sources.publisher: Department of Land Resources, Government of India and the respective state/UT governments
sources.role: 36-jurisdiction access directory is supplemented with later state government portals; URLs are access pointers, not bulk data feeds.

sources.name: Mizoram e-Ram / land revenue service
sources.publisher: Land Revenue & Settlement Department, Government of Mizoram
sources.role: Official land application service; limited statewide record coverage as stated by the department.

sources.name: Nagaland Land Records (ROR) portal
sources.publisher: Directorate of Land Records and Survey, Government of Nagaland
sources.role: Official portal for ROR/digital map and limited surveyed areas; not a complete State-wide title register.

sources.name: Nashik District land acquisition awards catalogue
sources.publisher: District Administration, Nashik, Government of Maharashtra
sources.role: Official award index with multiple final awards dated 2026; linked PDFs hold details.

sources.name: Kerala Revenue Department Government Orders index
sources.role: Official Revenue Department GO index with land-acquisition and award-extension orders; selected project-area values appear in titles.

sources.name: Tamil Nadu Extraordinary Gazette 2026

sources.role: Official Gazette index with 2026 land-acquisition notices under Highways and Industrial Purposes Acts.

sources.name: RIICO JPMIA land-acquisition office order
sources.publisher: Rajasthan State Industrial Development and Investment Corporation, Government of Rajasthan
sources.role: Official project-level order stating 1,086.4494 hectares acquired for JPMIA; parcel/owner schedule not bundled.

sources.name: GMADA land acquisition public notices

sources.role: Official public notice catalogue with village-related land acquisition PDFs; details require document extraction.

registrationActivityNationalTotals.note: Official dashboard total. Sum of displayed per-State/UT rounded revenue cells is INR 0.01 lakh lower; retain the dashboard's published aggregate total.

portalCoverage.note: The directory provides a government/state-authority service path for each jurisdiction where identified. A URL is not an open API. Meghalaya is explicitly marked as lacking a uniform statewide RoR; local authority records differ.
